notes.title: Keep Calm and PANIK On at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p][b]Does your morning brain cell need an extra shot of espresso? Strap in—during Steam Next Fest (June 2025) you can download the free [i]PANIK[/i] demo and find out whether:[/b][/p][p]Head over to the [i]PANIK[/i] Steam page, smash [b]“Play Demo,”[/b] and prove your blood runs colder than 0 °C. And if Level 5 leaves you sweating—hey, there’s always a Paniker to blame. 😉[/p][p]See you at Next Fest… or maybe you’ll see [i]us[/i] first before we start to PANIK![/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Minimalist visuals, unique mechanics, and a tongue-in-cheek story are waiting to hook you.[/b]
[/p][p]🧩 If you like what you see, adding the game to your wishlist helps me [i]enormously.[/i] For a solo indie dev, every little click means the world. 💛
[/p][p]💥 And yes—[i]PANIK[/i] is also heading to PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox soon. This is just the beginning![/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks a million for the support![/b][/p]

notes.title: DJ Panchi Plays PANIK live!
notes.content:
[p]Puzzle fans, mark your calendars! Tomorrow, Tuesday 10 June at 18:00 CEST, join us on [b]Yo, Yo Miself & the Indie[/b] for a special [i]PANIK[/i] showcase.[/p][p]
Across one action-packed hour DJ Panchi will:[/p][list][*][p]Play through the entire demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Interview ChumasGames’ solo dev for behind-the-scenes insights.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you like the challenges, don't enter in PANIK![/p]
